data.name: Dawn of the West
data.detailed_description:
Dawn of the West is a competitive multiplayer FPS set in a brutal, grounded vision of the Wild West — where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and team coordination decide who controls the frontier.

Every shot matters.
Every route matters.
Every second counts.

This isn’t a chaotic sandbox western — it’s a tightly tuned competitive battlefield where mechanical mastery and smart teamwork win the fight.

Capture the Frontier

Teams battle to capture and control strategic points across the map.

Each faction fields four distinct classes, bringing unique weapons, health pools, stamina capacity, and specialized attributes that influence how fast objectives are captured.

The right composition.
The right positioning.
The right timing.

That’s how you win the West.

Movement is a Weapon

Gunfights are lethal — but movement separates the good from the great.

Sprint to reposition, but manage your stamina carefully.
Use traversal movements to recover stamina faster and outmaneuver your opponents.

The battlefield is more than terrain — it’s a network of tactical routes waiting to be exploited.

The fastest team isn’t the one that runs the most.
It’s the one that moves smarter.

High Noon Showdown

When a round ends in a tie, the frontier settles it the only way it knows how.

One player from each team is chosen to face off in a sudden-death duel.

No teammates.
No second chances.
Just two gunslingers and one shot at victory.

Win the duel — win the round.

Built for Competitive Play

Every system is designed to reward skill.

Clean hit registration.
Predictable weapon behavior.
No artificial equalizers.

If you win, you earned it.

Key Features

  • Competitive multiplayer FPS set in a realistic Wild West

  • Objective-based territorial control

  • High Noon duel tiebreaker for tied rounds

  • 8 unique classes across two rival factions

  • Distinct weapons and attribute-driven roles

  • Stamina-based sprint and traversal system

  • Creative movement routes across the battlefield

  • Precision-focused, skill-driven gunplay

Early Access

Dawn of the West will launch in Early Access with peer-to-peer matches available at release.

Planned for full release:

  • Dedicated servers

  • Casual and Ranked matchmaking

  • Anti-cheat protection

  • An innovative secondary system to address unfair play

Developed over 3.5 years under the PXL Studios banner, Dawn of the West is a focused competitive experience shaped by passion, iteration, and community feedback.

data.short_description: Fight for control of the frontier in this competitive multiplayer Wild West FPS where precision gunplay, tactical movement, and class synergy decide every match. Capture objectives, master stamina-based traversal, and dominate the frontier through pure skill.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Performance target: 60+ FPS on Low/Medium settings at 1080p.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Performance target: 120+ FPS at 1080p on High/Epic settings.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of gun violence in a competitive multiplayer setting. Players shoot and eliminate opposing players using firearms. Small amounts of blood may be visible during combat. No graphic gore or dismemberment is depicted.
